sec2_body = paragraph(text="As warm, moist air ascends, it encounters lower atmospheric pressures and temperatures, expanding and cooling.   kind="tip",
  title="Cloud Condensation Nuclei",
  text="Without dust, pollen, or sea-salt crystals in the air, water vapor would struggle to condense even at high relative humidity."

sec3_body = paragraph(text="Within clouds, droplets collide and coalesce until gravity overcomes atmospheric updrafts. Water falls as precipitation—rain, snow, sleet, or hail.
